newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian zinc prices suffer losses on profit-taking.
newsitem.headline: Indian zinc prices suffer losses on profit-taking.

text.p: Indian zinc prices on Thursday suffered losses while nickel prices dropped further on world market lower trends, dealers said.
Other base metals remained steady in a narrow price band.
Zinc prices fell by 75 rupees at 7,500 per quintal on demand resistance. It was up by 25 rupees on Wednesday.
Nickel fell further by 100 rupees at 37,100 per quintal on renewed selling against sliding global prices.
Copper was steady at 13,350 rupees per quintal amid sluggish industrial buying but limited inflows helped prices to consolidate recent gains. It was up by 50 rupees on Wednesday.
Tin was steady at 31,500 on stray physical support.
Aluminium was quiet at 7,400, lead at 4,525 per quintal.
The Bombay metal market is closed on Friday for a local festival.
